premise: Meal hour in Arkham's female ward turns volatile when inmate predation, staff surveillance, and Magpie's fixation on a guard's shiny watch collide in public.
opening_text: The cafeteria concentrates Arkham's pecking order into one fluorescent room: trays, guards, gossip, humiliation, and nowhere to go when attention lands on the wrong person. A single theft attempt or taunt can turn routine into force almost instantly.
